cand_title: Jobs in Poland for Foreigners – How It Works | Alimat Group
cand_desc: How hiring works at Alimat Group: legal employment, help with paperwork and accommodation, a 24/7 coordinator. Answers to common questions.
cand_lead: We help foreign workers find stable, legal jobs in Poland and support them every step of the way.
faq_q1: Do you help foreigners get the right to work and stay in Poland?
faq_a1: Yes. We help you prepare the documents you need to work and stay in Poland legally.
faq_q2: Do I need to speak Polish?
faq_a2: Not always. We have jobs for people who don't speak any foreign language. If a job requires Polish, the listing says so.
faq_a3: Yes. We only offer legal forms of employment — depending on the position, an employment contract or a contract of mandate.
faq_q4: Do you provide accommodation and transport?
faq_a4: For most jobs we help with accommodation near the workplace, and transport to work is often free. Each listing gives the details.
faq_q5: Who will help me once I start working?
faq_a5: Every site has a coordinator you can reach 24/7.
faq_a6: Yes. Seasonal jobs come up depending on the time of year — ask a recruiter what's available now.
faq_a7: Some jobs are part-time or offer different shifts. Message us and we'll find the right fit.
faq_a8: Fill in the short form on this site or message us on WhatsApp, Viber or Telegram. A recruiter will get back to you.
